basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software developer from Vancouver, Canada, who loves gaming and experimenting with makeup. I discovered Reddit about a year and a half ago and have been an avid user ever since. In my free time, I enjoy diving into strategy games like WildCastle and exploring new trends in makeup. I'm single and often spend my evenings and weekends gaming or browsing Reddit. My typical online hours are late evenings after work and weekends. I work in a local tech startup focusing on cloud solutions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science, which gives me a solid foundation in tech and gaming. I am mostly self-taught in makeup, experimenting with different styles and techniques over the years. My interest in gaming strategy comes from years of playing and learning from online communities.
